O1.citation: “Re-run the full A/B/C suite with the edited skill—not just B.”

O2.citation: The artifact requires “a fresh, context-free runner” for each case, but does not explicitly require a separate evidence-based judge; “followed by grading” leaves judge separation unspecified.

O3.citation: Evidence is missing: the artifact specifies neither repeated trials nor per-case pass rates sufficient to expose nondeterminism.

O4.citation: Evidence is missing: the artifact does not require diagnosing a new miss as a skill defect versus a bad case, nor repeating the diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop.

O5.citation: “Per-case findings tied to the bars, yielding movement from 2/3 before to 3/3 after,” plus evidence that B’s “original cited gap is resolved.”

S1.citation: The smell is absent: “Re-run the full A/B/C suite with the edited skill—not just B.”

S2.citation: The smell is absent: the artifact requires “a fresh, context-free runner” for each case and does not recommend context reuse.

S3.citation: The smell is absent: the artifact does not state that the runner grades its own output, although it also fails to explicitly require a separate judge.

S4.citation: The smell is absent: “Per-case findings tied to the bars” are required, rather than only an aggregate score.

S5.citation: The smell is absent: “A and C still pass, proving the B-specific edit caused no regressions.”

rationale: The artifact correctly requires a full A/B/C regression sweep and legible before-and-after case findings, but it omits three essential safeguards: an explicitly separate evidence-based judge, repeated trials with per-case pass rates, and diagnosis of new misses followed by an iterative diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop.
